name: model-lifecycle-roadmap
summary: Near-term Milestone 1 stages name the full model lifecycle as thin slices instead of compressing catalog, metadata, feasibility, selection, acquisition, inventory, admission and inference instance into Model Presence / Admission / Inference. Depth stays in Milestones 2–4. No product code. Stage 1.3 not begun.

refined_forward_sequence.1.2A: closed — Storage Sanity + Prototype Console; not reopened
refined_forward_sequence.1.3: closed at L2 — Runtime / Executor exoskeleton
refined_forward_sequence.1.4A: closed at L1 — curated catalog, ModelMetadata, ModelRequirement v0
refined_forward_sequence.1.4B: closed at L1 — interchangeable estimators, SAFE-capacity selection, DeploymentPlan v0
refined_forward_sequence.1.5B: InferenceInstance lifecycle — plural schema; one running instance acceptable
refined_forward_sequence.1.8: Milestone 1 L4 gate — unchanged in purpose, steps name the thin lifecycle

multi_model.first_vertical: several models stored, one inference instance running
multi_model.later_gate: Stage 4.4 — two concurrent inference instances on real hardware

invariants: storage state is not runtime state
same artifact may have many instances
many models may run when hardware permits
request concurrency is not instance concurrency
frontend does not own product logic
capacity, reservation and utilization stay separate
desired, observed and health stay separate
next: Stage 1.4C — Model acquisition + plural Model Inventory, using the Part V brief. Do not begin Stage 1.5A from 1.4C.
